items.label: Coherent Q4 FY2026 (08-12-2026)
items.signal_prefix: INDIUM PHOSPHIDE IS THE PRIMARY CONSTRAINT on the whole business

set.signal: INDIUM PHOSPHIDE IS THE PRIMARY CONSTRAINT on the whole business — 'we're not constrained in the assembly and test capacity right now... we're really just constrained by the ramp of the indium phosphide production.' Internal InP output capacity doubles YoY by the end of the current quarter, ONE QUARTER AHEAD of the original plan, and is on track to MORE THAN DOUBLE AGAIN by the end of calendar 2027; substrates and other critical inputs for that ramp are already secured, and capacity beyond 2027 is being planned. Concrete measure: Coherent produced about 80% MORE indium phosphide lasers in the June quarter than a year earlier — those lasers feed 800G and 1.6T transceiver shipments in the current quarter, so management expects data-center revenue growth this quarter to EXCEED 80% YoY. Six-inch lines in TEXAS and SWEDEN are producing EMLs, CW lasers and photodiodes with yields that exceed the 3-inch lines across all three device types; a third 6-inch location in ZURICH starts in the first half of calendar 2027. Six-inch economics: 4x the output per wafer at half the cost.

items.reason: The quoted words were not verbatim (the CEO said 'in the assembly and test capacity').
items.evidence: we're not constrained in the assembly and test capacity right now. We have that capacity available. We're really just constrained by the ramp of the indium phosphide production.

items.label: Coherent Q4 FY2026 (08-12-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Visibility and balance sheet. Record bookings again in Q4

set.signal: Visibility and balance sheet. Record bookings again in Q4: FISCAL 2027 IS BASICALLY COMPLETELY BOOKED OUT and backlog runs through the end of CALENDAR 2027, with customers now placing purchase orders into CALENDAR 2028; customer LTAs extend THROUGH THE END OF THE DECADE and generally carry increasing supply each year, pricing commitments, and minimum demand guarantees (take-or-pay). 'We continue to see no signs of attenuation in customer demand.' Q4 capex $556M (versus $290M in Q3 and $131M a year earlier) and expected to rise sequentially again in Q1; data-center investments carry a roughly 18-MONTH PAYBACK and the capacity is fungible across product lines. Year-end cash $2.59B (from $3.05B in Q3 and $1.63B at end FY2025). Gross margin has risen in EIGHT OF THE PAST NINE QUARTERS for a cumulative improvement of over 660bps; the Investor Day target is >42% (Q1 guide midpoint 40.5%) and management says it will raise the target once reached. Opex is already below the 18% target model at the Q1 guide midpoint.
set.figure: FY27 booked out, orders into CY2028, LTAs to end of decade; Q4 capex $556M, ~18-mo payback

items.reason: The CFO said 'over 660 basis points'; the 'over' was lost. Verifier: debt payments and the leverage ratio are financing terms (skill section 2) and come out of signal and figure.
items.evidence: The accumulation of improvement that we've driven in those eight quarters is over 660 basis points of improvement.

items.label: Coherent Q4 FY2026 (08-12-2026)
items.signal_prefix: New product lines beyond transceivers. OCS:

set.signal: New product lines beyond transceivers. OCS: revenue increased sequentially in Q4 and is expected to grow significantly through fiscal 2027 as production expands across TWO manufacturing locations; the addressable market estimate remains MORE THAN $4 BILLION (doubled from $2B at OFC earlier in 2026; CEO: 'I think that was for a 2030 timeframe') and management says even that may prove conservative. Applications have widened from the original scale-out focus to scale-across and now a clear path to SCALE-UP, where there are active customer engagements; demand spans the 320x320 platform and other system sizes. MULTI-RAIL (scale-across AI networking between data centers): more than $2 BILLION addressable market by calendar 2030, samples recently delivered to multiple customers, initial revenue ramping in the FIRST HALF OF CALENDAR 2027. THERMADITE thermal material for XPU cooling: samples delivered to multiple strategic customers, revenue ramping in the SECOND HALF OF CALENDAR 2027, improving thermal performance to enable higher XPU performance and more AI token generation per XPU.

items.reason: The 2030 timeframe was the CEO's hedged recollection ('I think').
items.evidence: We doubled it from 2 to over 4 billion. We may have even been conservative on that $4 billion number in terms of the addressable market over time. I think that was for a 2030 timeframe.
